intro:
Dabhoi carries its history openly - the fortified old town, with its carved stone gates, is one of the reasons people from well beyond Vadodara district know the name. A wedding here often has that same sense of occasion, and a baraat winding past the old walls toward a modern venue has a genuinely striking contrast to it.

Plan My Baraat brings the full entry together as one booking for Dabhoi families: the double decker Baraat on Wheels truck, a dhol team, a vintage car or baggi for the groom's arrival, and the My Safa team turban-styling him and the full baraati group before the walk begins.
localArea:
Dabhoi sits southeast of Vadodara city, and while its heart is the old fortified town, most wedding venues booked today are in the newer areas around it, with wider approach roads that suit a truck our size comfortably. We plan our route in advance for any venue close to the historic core, since those older lanes can be tighter than the town's outer roads.

We've handled entries in Dabhoi itself and in the smaller villages surrounding it, and families here tend to want a baraat that matches the town's character - a bit more grandeur, a bit more show, given how much of a talking point Dabhoi weddings already are locally.
whatsIncluded:
Every package includes the DJ truck, sound system, and a DJ artist keeping the crowd engaged as the baraat moves. Raj Tilak adds 2 dhol and chhatri lighting overhead. Rajwada steps up to 4 dhol with a teddy or gorilla performer working alongside the truck. Maharaja, the package most Dabhoi families choose, brings moving LED panels and lights up the groom's name as he approaches. Signature, the top package, adds a security team, timed pyro and confetti, and an upgraded American vintage car.

The vintage car or baggi and the My Safa turban team come standard from Raj Tilak upward, so even the entry package gives Dabhoi families a proper royal arrival, not a scaled-down one.
whyUs:
We're a Vadodara-based baraat planning team, which puts Dabhoi comfortably within our regular working area - our drivers know the approach to the old town, and our dhol players and safa artists have handled enough Dabhoi weddings to be genuinely comfortable with the setup here.

Booking one team for the truck, dhol, car, and safa means fewer moving parts to manage yourself in the final week. We handle the timing so the truck's arrival, the dhol beat, and the groom's step out of the vintage car all land together at your Dabhoi venue.
pricingGuidance:
Pricing for a Dabhoi baraat depends on the package, the dhol count, and whether you want extras like pyro or confetti. Raj Tilak is the most affordable way to get the full core setup right; Signature costs more because the production genuinely scales up, with more dhol, LED visuals, a security team, and the premium car.

Send us your wedding date, your venue or area in Dabhoi, and roughly how many people are in the baraat, and we'll respond on WhatsApp with a real quote, usually within the hour.
planningNotes:
Wedding season around Dabhoi runs November through February, and 2 to 3 weeks' notice during that stretch is usually enough since this belt sees less competition for dates than Vadodara's central venues. Outside season, a week's notice typically works fine.

If your venue is near Dabhoi's old fort area, flag that when you message us - we'll plan the truck's route and parking around those narrower approach lanes ahead of time.
